correctness.rationale: The invariant-line identity is exact; the system has only the origin as a finite equilibrium; planar index plus trajectory uniqueness excludes every periodic orbit. The explicit point alpha=beta=1/10, a=-10 satisfies the conjecture hypotheses exactly.

originality.rationale: No correction or source-specific refutation of Lu-Zhang Conjecture 5.1 was found. A 2025 paper classifies invariant algebraic curves for the ambient family, so invariant-line classification is expressly excluded from the novelty claim; its unavailable full text is retained as the principal residual overlap risk.

value.rationale: The result gives an exact continuum of no-periodic-orbit parameters inside a recently conjectured universal limit-cycle region, including a simple rational-coefficient counterexample.
